content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Rent prices are already regulated in favour of tenants due to existing laws and the rent index. In view of the high prices for buying flats with existing rent contracts, these are an unattractive investment. Even if one might think that additional rent control is needed besides the current tenant protection, one should not deny longstanding owners the opportunity to adjust their returns to market level. A cap on rent increases upon tenant change is therefore not to be supported.
What is the relation between "one should not deny longstanding owners the opportunity to adjust their returns to market level." and "Even if one might think that additional rent control is needed besides the current tenant protection," from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
